messages.text: BL-1920 🎵 in progress — Stamp-off for hotfixes 0d44613b74, 0eb5958ab6 and 59a376845a: a local-model seat that announced actions instead of calling tools sees its own tool calls in its history, and a reply that announces an action ("I will now run ready_for_next.sh", "Let's proceed") and calls no tool is asked once more to make the call, never when the seat is idle on NO_TASK
